7107123.name: Chabad of King Township
7107123.note: COLlive, 7 Sept 2025 ('New Shluchim to King Township, Ontario'): 'King Township, Ontario, will now have its first permanent Chabad presence with the arrival of Rabbi Naftoli and Mushkie Shanowitz as Shluchim'; 'Until now, the area has not had a full-time Chabad presence'. Its chabad.org listing went up 26 Nov 2025.

3108509.name: Ohr Temimim
3108509.note: COLlive, 25 Mar 2017 ('Toronto Mesivta Opens New Horizons'): 'Mesivta Ohr Temimim is a Lubavitch moisad located in Toronto'; 'In its successful two years of operation'; 'The Mesivta was opened in response to an overwhelming demand' (Rabbi Eliezer Posner, menahel). Medium: counted back; its chabad.org listing went up 30 Oct 2015, which agrees.
